allowed: On the frozen 18-document REALSTRUCT-2 convenience sample, BITE preserved the frozen safety invariants on all documents.
BITE reduced model-visible tokens relative to adapter_only on 1 of 18 documents.
On the single matched-budget document, BITE retained all unique assignment identities while prefix truncation retained 84.6%.
On the single reference-gold document, retrospectively corrected reference retention was 1.0 for both BITE and the matched length arm.
phase4_conclusion: Phase 4 established a reproducible real-structured evaluation path, full-source safety under the frozen protocol, and one prospective four-arm convenience-sample measurement. The sample provided limited opportunity to evaluate BITE transformations because operator activation was sparse.
